steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
Choose Fit-out budget.
Name it, with carpet area and seats so it can show cost per sq ft and per seat.
Budget lines: quantity × unit price, with tax % on each line (never assumed).
Add two partner quotations — price before tax, tax, delivery and warranty.
Compare & save — the totals and the ranking are fixed formulas, not AI.
The budget total, with tax shown separately, and cost per sq ft and per seat.
Estimated, approved and actual are kept apart. 'Unknown' means not entered yet — not zero.
Variances show how far approved and actual costs moved from the estimate.
Quotes ranked on price, scope, timeline and warranty — the weights are shown.
Quoted = from a landlord or partner document; Estimated = your own assumption. The label follows the number everywhere.
Each save is a version. Change any input and recalculate — earlier versions are kept, never overwritten.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
Now Financing: how to pay for the fit-out.
A ₹2 crore loan at 11% over 36 months, after a ₹45 lakh client contribution.
Calculate & save.
The EMI, total interest and the full repayment schedule — calculated, not estimated by AI.
Repayment schedule: each month's interest on the opening balance, and how much goes to the loan.
Quoted = from a landlord or partner document; Estimated = your own assumption. The label follows the number everywhere.
How we calculated this: the formula version and every step, so anyone can check the maths.
